naf36e4a973.headline: Nigeria to launch digital currency, central bank says
naf36e4a973.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria announced plans to launch the eNaira, a digital currency operating as a wallet linked to customers' existing bank accounts.
naf36e4a973.why: Central bank digital currencies can transform payment systems, financial inclusion, and monetary policy implementation in emerging markets.
naf36e4a973.why_moved: The introduction of a central bank digital currency is a significant innovation affecting Nigeria's financial system and investor interest.
